reference.role: style, painterly scale, and texture-density reference only

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless square albedo texture for a stylized 3D game terrain material
Input image: the supplied ground-basecolor.png is a style, painterly scale, and texture-density reference only
Primary request: create a new warm Sunmane desert sandy-soil albedo that matches the reference's soft hand-painted mottling and feature scale
Composition/framing: orthographic flat surface filling a square canvas; truly seamless/tileable across every edge; no focal point
Color palette: warm ochre sand, muted terracotta-brown soil, restrained pale sandstone accents
Materials/textures: fine grain with sparse subtle small embedded stone flecks; broad low-contrast painterly variation; natural irregularity
Lighting/mood: pure diffuse albedo with uniform neutral illumination
Constraints: opaque RGB image; preserve the reference's painterly scale; texture should repeat cleanly; terrain only
Avoid: grass or green hues, dunes, ripples, cracks, large rocks, distinct objects, footprints, tracks, horizon, perspective, directional shadows, ambient occlusion, specular highlights, baked lighting, borders, text, logos, watermark

pbrSupport.note: Existing neutral ground micro-detail maps are reused; no generated height, normal, or ORM data.
